notes:
Summary: Mid-size legaltech vendor building contract-analysis SaaS. POC completed but ultimately lost interest due to perceived quality regression compared to incumbent (JurisAI/LexiServe) and longer security review. Sales cycle had healthy technical engagement but no strong champion after GC left.

Highlights:
- Primary workload: clause extraction + structured JSON outputs for downstream RPA (fields: clause_type, obligation, effective_date).
- Latency/throughput: soft SLOs 200ms p95 for single-doc extract; batch throughput for nightly indexing 250-500 docs/min.
- Model preference: open-model variants acceptable, but must match incumbent F1 on clause extraction and produce deterministic JSON schema.
- Must support VPC deployment or on-prem with KMS integration and audit trail for regulatory customers.

What happened in POC / why stalled:
- POC ran Oct-Nov 2025: Redwood baseline achieved good latency and cost numbers, but automated eval showed drop in structured extraction F1 after a model variant update (v1.2 -> v1.3). Incumbent maintained higher stable F1 (0.94 vs Redwood 0.86 on our eval set).
- Tool-calling / function-calling issues: Redwood's tool/fn-calls returned inconsistent keys and occasional nulls; downstream RPA failed mapping step in 12% of cases — flagged by Argentum engineering as "unacceptable for production workflows."
- Regression surfaced post-internal model swap during POC; Argentum perceived this as stability risk.
- Security: deep security questionnaire sent; internal procurement extended timeline due to SOC2/ISO checklist and required signed DPA. Redwood provided docs but Argentum requested on-prem proof-of-concept which lengthened cycle.
- Org change: Head of Product (internal champion) left Dec 2025; no clear owner to drive procurement.
- Budget: Q1 2026 hiring/budget freeze across GTM; finance deprioritized new vendor onboarding.

Quotes / call fragments:
- "We saw hallucinated clause IDs and missing obligation fields after the update — can't ship that." — Sr. Eng on 2026-01-22 call.
- "If Redwood can give us a reproducible eval harness and regression SLA, we can re-open conversation." — Legaltech CTO.

Activities timeline:
- 2025-09-15: Intro call; AE demo (Leah Park).
- 2025-10-05: Technical deep dive with SE (Diego Ramos) — schema requirements + sample data sent.
- 2025-10-28: POC kickoff; baseline dataset (5k contracts) ingested.
- 2025-11-12: Mid-POC sync — noted latency OK; flagged structured output mismatches.
- 2025-12-08: Model upgrade (v1.3) to improve throughput — regression observed in extractors.
- 2026-01-22: Final POC review (FF: ff-2026-01-22-poc-review) — Argentum recommends continuing with incumbent.
- 2026-02-14: Last outreach attempt re: mitigation plan; unresponsive after finance update.

Action items / next steps (CRM):
- Document and share regression root-cause analysis + per-field F1 breakdown (was promised 2026-02-01, delayed).
- Provide replayable eval harness + sample dataset + instruction on pinning model variants to avoid surprise updates.
- Offer limited on-prem pilot (timeboxed) to satisfy security/compliance checks — requires SOW and legal sign-off.
- Re-nurture cadence: quarterly check-ins; re-engage if budget re-opens or new champion emerges.

Probability / internal read: 10% re-open within 6 months. Primary risk: Argentum went with LexiServe citing higher extraction stability and existing contract. Secondary: budget freeze + no champion.

Internal notes for AE/SE:
- Emphasize Redwood Optimize suggestions (quantization/packing) only after quality parity confirmed.
- Capture exact failure cases (3-5 canonical examples) to demonstrate fixes to Argentum.
- Engage Product for regression SLA offering and pinning controls in Console.

Jira refs: INF-4219 (fn-call mapping bug), SEC-3397 (on-prem packaging questions).
